title: Skin Care for Dehradun Weather: A Routine for Dry Summers, Heavy Monsoon and Cold Valley Winters
ex: Hot dry summers, one of north India's wettest monsoons and cold foggy winters: a simple skin care routine for people living in Dehradun.
rt: Skin Care for Dehradun Weather: Seasonal Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Dehradun weather: sun care for dry summers, light layers in the heavy monsoon and a richer routine for cold, foggy valley winters.
quick: Dehradun has a hot, fairly dry summer, a very wet monsoon from July to September and a cold winter with foggy mornings. Keep a gentle face wash and daily broad-spectrum sunscreen all year, use lighter layers and half the night cream in the monsoon, and a richer moisturiser and full pea-sized night cream in winter.
facts: Dehradun sits in the Doon valley between the Shivaliks and the lower Himalaya
April to June is hot with strong sun
July to September brings heavy monsoon rain and high humidity
December to February is cold with foggy mornings and heater use
